description: This file defines interfaces and data structures for a GStreamer utility wrapper in the Rialto server component. It includes class declarations for a wrapper interface, a factory for creating instances, and related data structures for playback and audio attributes, with external dependencies on GStreamer and standard C++ libraries.

classes.name: IRdkGstreamerUtilsWrapper
classes.description: Interface class for GStreamer utility functions, including a method to perform audio track codec channel switching.

classes.name: IRdkGstreamerUtilsWrapperFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of IRdkGstreamerUtilsWrapper.

methods.name: createRdkGstreamerUtilsWrapper
methods.description: Pure virtual method to create an instance of IRdkGstreamerUtilsWrapper.
